description.zh: WAF规则组名称，最大128字符。新建自定义WAF规则组时必填。
description.en: The name of the WAF rule group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. This parameter is required when you create a custom WAF rule group.

description.zh:
是否订阅：取值：
- **on**：开启
- **off**：关闭

复制其他自定义规则组时不传。
description.en:
Specifies whether to subscribe to the rule group. Valid values:

- **on**: The subscription is enabled.
- **off**: The subscription is disabled.

Do not specify this parameter when you copy another custom rule group.

description.zh:
待复制规则组ID。
复制自定义WAF规则组时必填。
您可以通过[DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~)接口查询对应的规则组ID。无模板传0或不传。
description.en: The ID of the rule group to copy. This parameter is required when you copy a custom WAF rule group. You can call the [DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~) operation to query the ID of the rule group. If you do not use a template, set this parameter to 0 or leave it unspecified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn create-dcdn-waf-group --name test --template-id 0 --subscribe on --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn CreateDcdnWafGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Subscribe on --TemplateId 0 --Name test
